rationale: Revision 3 resolves the changed product scope and my financial-resource objections. Permissionless developer deployment is explicitly separate from user asset authority and internal Pel controls. Signed intentions bind concrete assets/substitution predicates, complete effects and permitted partial outcomes. Mandatory correctness and history claims remain non-vacuous. The candidate now explicitly includes the material Midnight guaranteed/fallible phase distinction confirmed in my fresh source review. It preserves residual liabilities, cumulative bounds, uncertain execution and conditional recovery rather than treating proof verification as completed settlement. Certified primitives and exact advisory checking remain subordinate to actual source-to-target correspondence. This is an advisory architectural endorsement, not implementation, proof or release acceptance.
caveats: The Midnight phase claim is documented in the official Transaction semantics page, updated September 18, 2026, sections Transaction fallibility and Phase execution. Mapping it to Moriarty requires the exact deployed version and emitted transaction shape; this research did not execute that backend. The proposed SET-MOR requirements and failure scenarios should be incorporated into the new OpenSpec contract.

All-outcome authority accounting must include guaranteed-phase fees and effects even where the fallible financial operation fails. A refund or later compensation cannot erase prior gross debit, discharged work or unresolved exposure. A success-only proof predicate would not satisfy this plan.

An authenticated attestation establishes endorsement under a named policy, not external truth. Proofs consuming observations must retain their dependencies; arbitrary witness values need actual circuit constraints. Currentness, unique consumption and canonical finality remain ledger obligations.

Cross-chain safety/liveness claims must name their timing and ledger assumptions. IBC timeout semantics illustrate why silence does not establish non-receipt; Kachina Appendix F separately models liveness. A global rollback or unconditional remedy claim would contradict the endorsed scope.

I did not independently audit the newly summarized PR17 Agda development, recovered jet workstream or precise current ZKIRv3 instruction inventory in this settlement review. I endorse their stated verification obligations and conditional status, not their empirical completion. Those source-specific facts require the designated reviewers evidence.

The six-reviewer decision concerns the exact candidate text. Diataxis notes and source captures are research artifacts with explicitly partial PDF reading, not formal theorem audits or approval receipts for future code.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: A product contract or actual deployment path requiring maintainer receipts, an application solver whitelist, or program-by-program administrative registration for ordinary supported Moriarty programs.
A lowerer or verifier admitting a phase layout whose surviving failure effects exceed signed authority, silently resets retry budgets, or reports financial success without the promised net outcome.

A proof relation that validates only honest witness generation, omits mandatory history/intent claims, promotes attested facts to independently proved observations, or leaves predecessor consumption to an unchecked host assertion.

Pinned target evidence contradicting the candidate phase or ZKIR facts without a scoped correction, or verified compiler/circuit cost results showing the proposed primitive/composition route cannot meet the admitted target limits.

Conversely, independently reviewed phase-aware positive/negative readbacks, hostile-witness constraint tests, source-to-ZKIRv3 correspondence and proof-enabled Midnight acceptance would justify stronger implementation claims than this advisory endorsement.
